title: 1861 baptism of Sotero Lebrón, rejected candidate
repository: Santos Ángeles Custodios, Yabucoa, via FamilySearch
citation: DGS 007769018, local image 110. The child is Sotero Lebrón, not Sotero Vázquez Rodríguez, and the page is retained as a rejected search candidate.

title: 1806 baptismal ceremonies for Juana Jacinta Vázquez Rivera
repository: Dulce Nombre de Jesús, Humacao, via FamilySearch
citation: DGS 008038522, item 7, local image 455 of 469. On 28 August 1806 the parish supplied baptismal ceremonies to Juana Jacinta, born 16 August, legitimate daughter of Máximo Vázquez and Josefa de Rivera. León Piñero had baptized her at home because of danger of death; godparents were Bartolomé de Rivera and María Rodríguez. The FamilySearch computer index incorrectly calls the child Jesús by capturing text from the church heading.

title: 1819 baptism of Juan de Dios Vázquez Rivera
repository: Nuestra Señora de la Inmaculada Concepción, Juncos, via FamilySearch
citation: DGS 008126787, item 3, local image 78 of 174. Juan de Dios was born 9 March and baptized 14 March 1819 in Juncos, legitimate son of Máximo Vázquez, native of Caguas, and Josefa de Ribera, native of Humacao. The parents were described as pardos libres. The computer index incorrectly dated the birth to 1813 and baptism to 1814; the original reads 1819.

title: 1879 baptism of Dolores Vázquez Rodríguez
repository: Nuestra Señora de las Mercedes, San Lorenzo, via FamilySearch
citation: DGS 008126780, item 9, local image 37 of 313, entry 87. Dolores, born 1 December 1878 and baptized 7 March 1879, was the legitimate daughter of Francisco Solano Vázquez and Rita Rodríguez. Paternal grandparents Máximo Vázquez and Josefa Rivera identify Francisco Solano as a son of the exact parent pair.

title: 1878 death of Francisco Solano Vázquez Rivera
repository: Nuestra Señora de las Mercedes, San Lorenzo, via FamilySearch
citation: DGS 008126779, item 4, local image 141 of 311. Burial was recorded 31 December 1878 for Francisco Solano Vázquez Rivera, age 40, husband of Rita Rodríguez and son of Máximo Vázquez and Josefa Rivera; the entry says he died the previous day. Automated transcription and indexing misread Solano as Polanco. His daughter Dolores's baptism independently writes Francisco Solano and repeats his parents.

title: 1897 baptism of Mariana Vázquez de Santiago
repository: Nuestra Señora del Carmen, Cidra, via FamilySearch
citation: DGS 008124903, item 2, local image 147 of 276. Mariana was born 18 April 1896 and baptized 19 December 1897, daughter of Atilano Vázquez and Juana Santiago. Paternal grandparents were indexed as Maximiliano Vázquez and Josefa Rivera; maternal grandparents were Tomás Santiago and Petronila Orellana. The repeated spouse and parent pair identify the same Atilano and Juana Paula de Santiago.

title: 1850 baptism of María Balbina Vázquez Rodríguez
repository: Santos Ángeles Custodios, Yabucoa, via FamilySearch
citation: DGS 007769018, item 1, local image 101. María Balbina was born 31 May 1850 and baptized 25 June 1850 in Yabucoa, legitimate daughter of Atilano Vázquez and Juana Rodríguez. The transcript identifies maternal grandparents Andrés Rodríguez and Francisca Díaz and godparents Juan Martínez and Francisca Díaz. The paternal-grandparent line is difficult in the automated transcript; the original and attached index align with the already documented Máximo Vázquez and Josefa Rivera pair, but that line should still be read cautiously.

title: 1897 Yabucoa burial indexed as Eladia Vázquez, unresolved same-family identity
repository: Santos Ángeles Custodios, Yabucoa, via FamilySearch
citation: Yabucoa burial recorded 9 December 1897 after death the previous day. The index treats the deceased as male Eladia Vázquez, age 25, child of Atilano Vázquez and Juana Rodríguez; an attached tree instead links Juan Vázquez y Rodríguez, 1866–1897. The name, age, chronology, and attached identity conflict, so the record is retained but not added as a confirmed child.

title: 1898 death of a different Sotero Vázquez, rejected same-name candidate
repository: Santos Ángeles Custodios, Yabucoa, via FamilySearch
citation: The record concerns a Sotero Vázquez reported about age 50 and identifies his parents as Tomás and Rosa. Those parents exclude the direct ancestor, whose records repeatedly name Atilano Vázquez and Juana Rodríguez. The image is retained under the all-candidates rule.

title: Manual scan of Yabucoa baptism item 3, 1848–1856
repository: Santos Ángeles Custodios, Yabucoa, DGS 007769018, via FamilySearch
citation: All 146 local images in item 3 were reviewed for Sotero, Atilano, Juana Regina, Máximo, Josefa Rivera, Andrés, and Francisca Díaz. No defensible baptism for Sotero Vázquez Rodríguez was found. FamilySearch labels the item as 1927–1957, but the pages themselves are nineteenth-century entries extending through 1856; the misleading title is preserved in a screenshot.

title: Yabucoa baptism collection coverage gap: 1843–1847 and after 1856
repository: Santos Ángeles Custodios, Yabucoa, DGS 007769018, via FamilySearch
citation: FamilySearch's Information panel identifies DGS 007769018 item 2 as Yabucoa baptisms 1838–1842. Item 3 contains baptisms 1848–1856. The image-group heading describes baptism holdings only through 1856 before later marriage items. No baptism item for 1843–1847 or 1857–1860 appears in this image group.
note: This is evidence that the target years are absent from this digitized image group, not evidence that Sotero lacked a baptism. Search an unfilmed register, duplicate parish book, diocesan copy, archive inventory, or neighboring parish.

title: Juana Regina Rodríguez death search and Yabucoa coverage gap, 1863–1870
repository: Santos Ángeles Custodios, Yabucoa, via FamilySearch
citation: Exact and variant searches under Juana, Regina, and Rodríguez did not isolate her death. The available Yabucoa death item reviewed begins in July 1871, after the established death window of 9 July 1863 to 10 February 1870. The result is a coverage gap, not proof that no local burial record existed.

title: 1882 baptism of Mauricio Reyes Martínez
repository: Dulce Nombre de Jesús, Humacao, via FamilySearch
citation: DGS 008038529, item 9, local image 278 of 346, register page 236. Mauricio was baptized 23 February 1882, legitimate son of Pedro Reyes and Ana Martínez. Paternal grandparents Ramón Reyes and Inés Castro; maternal grandparents Dámaso Martínez and María Rivera; godparents Eugenio Miranda and Rosenda Ramos. The birth statement says 22 September 'de este año,' chronologically impossible in a February 1882 baptism; 1881 is likely but is not silently supplied as fact.

title: 1877 baptism of Benito Isabel Reyes Martínez
repository: Dulce Nombre de Jesús, Humacao, via FamilySearch
citation: DGS 008038526, item 6, local image 169 of 337, register page 135. Benito Isabel was born 8 July and baptized 15 September 1877, described as the legitimate son of Pedro Reyes and Ana Martínez. Paternal grandparents Ramón Reyes and Inés Castro; maternal grandfather Dámaso Martínez. The maternal grandmother's given name is María, but her surname is difficult to read and conflicts with the clearer Rivera form in Mauricio's 1882 baptism. Godparents Benito Rosario and Valentina Rodríguez.

title: 1910 United States Federal Census: Pedro Reyes, Ana Martínez, and Julián Reyes
repository: U.S. National Archives via FamilySearch
citation: Anton Ruiz, Humacao, enumeration district 822, sheets 5B–6A, enumerated 20–21 April 1910. Pedro Reyes, 60, head, appears on line 50 of sheet 5B; wife Ana Martínez de Reyes, 55, and son Julián Reyes y Martínez, 22, continue on lines 1–2 of sheet 6A. The marital columns report this as Pedro's second marriage and Ana's first, married 35 years; Ana reports seven children born and four living.

title: 1844 baptism of Ana Martínez, rejected direct-ancestor candidate
repository: Dulce Nombre de Jesús, Humacao, via FamilySearch
citation: DGS 008038525, item 6, local image 35 of 201. The index identifies Ana, born 26 July 1844 and baptized in October 1844, daughter of Dámaso Martínez and María Rivera. The original is severely obscured by bleed-through. This exact-name parent-pair candidate is retained but not merged because the direct Ana reported age 55 in 1910 and age 60 in 1918, placing her birth about 1854–1858 rather than 1844.

title: 1958 death of Anastacia Reyes Villafañe
repository: Registro Civil de Humacao via FamilySearch
citation: Anastacia Reyes Villafañe died 10 May 1958 in Humacao, reported age 91. The original names her parents Pedro Reyes and Juana Villafañe, confirming an earlier child of Pedro's first family and a paternal half-sister of Mauricio.

title: 1897 death of Pedro Reyes Villafañe
repository: Registro Civil de Humacao via FamilySearch
citation: Pedro Reyes Villafañe died 24 September 1897 in Humacao, reported age 25, and was registered the next day. The original names his parents Pedro Reyes and Juana Villafañe, confirming an earlier child of Pedro's first family and a paternal half-brother of Mauricio.
